svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
CG on the hover thrust line, Y 12.86 in (326.7 mm)
Balance the aircraft on the tilt axis: CG target = hover thrust line, Y 12.86 in (326.7 mm) aft
Zero each AK7455 at 0 deg (cruise) with the angle gauge.
Sweep each nacelle -5 -> 135 deg; both track within 2 deg at 0 and 90 deg.
Verify the nozzle schedule: 75 % at 0 deg, 105 % from 90 to 140 deg.
Procedure pending the Rev T+ re-audit of guide Phases 4-11 (graphical-build-guide/WBS.md 1.5.6).
This card shows the Rev T+ architecture only; follow the authority documents named below.
